Colored Tables

Tables support colored rows using a comment directive placed before each row.

Syntax

Place a comment before the row you want to color:


| Resource | Amount |
| -------- | ------ |
| Coal | 100 |

| Iron | 75 |

| Copper | 50 |

Available Colors

blue, red, green, yellow, orange, purple, cyan, grey

Example: Resource Inventory

Example: Color Reference

ColorClassUse Case
BlueblueInformation, neutral data
GreengreenSuccess, good status
YellowyellowWarning, low values
RedredError, critical alerts
OrangeorangeCaution, moderate concern
PurplepurpleSpecial, highlighted items
CyancyanAlternative neutral
GreygreyInactive, disabled
